description:
Compare every exchange's offer for a swap, best first.

In each quote, amount_to is what the user receives after all fees. With amount_to given instead of amount,
quotes are sorted by amount_from, what the user sends. errors lists the exchanges that can't, and why (with
their min/max when the amount is out of range); with no quote at all, limits has the widest min/max: suggest
an amount inside it. savings_pct: how much more the best quote gives than the worst. Ask again after
refresh_after seconds, not sooner.

RateType.description:
`float`: the market rate when the deposit arrives. `fixed`: what you receive is locked when the swap is
created, usually at a slightly worse rate.

amount.description: Amount of from_asset to send. Pass this or amount_to.

amount_to.description: Exact amount of to_asset to receive, instead of amount (fixed rate only).

from_asset.description: Asset to send: 'btc', 'usdt:trx', or a ticker with from_network.

from_network.description: Network of from_asset, when its ticker is on several: a code or a name ('trx', 'tron', 'erc20').

providers.description: Only ask these exchanges (ids from list_providers).

rate_type.description: 'float': the market rate when the deposit arrives, usually more. 'fixed': an amount guaranteed for a short time. Default float, or fixed with amount_to.

to_network.description: Network of to_asset, when its ticker is on several.

name: get_quotes
title: Compare swap rates
